headline: Residents testify on hotel zoning proposals for apartment units

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.summary: Residents testified on proposals to move apartment units into H3 and H4 hotel zoning; many said the proposals undermine Bill 9.
meeting.recap: A testifier said some agenda items are an attempt to undermine Bill 9.[[0:16:45]] The testifier said a list of units is proposed for H3 and H4 zoning.[[0:18:23]] Another testifier said Bill 9 hearings showed that water limits building more affordable housing.[[0:21:04]] A high school agriculture teacher testified and brought senior students.[[0:29:37]] Council Member Johnson joined the meeting online.[[0:44:07]] A testifier worried about how many properties the Planning Commission would have to review.[[0:45:25]] One testifier supported passing the amendments for H3 and H4 zoning.[[1:07:43]] A fire survivor said they are still in limbo after losing their home.[[1:17:37]] A testifier said the need for local housing will grow if FEMA pulls out in early 2027.[[1:23:08]] A testifier said about 26 properties are proposed for hotel zoning, with six minutes given for public testimony.[[1:50:41]] A testifier for one property said a document banning transient (short-stay) rentals was only a draft.[[2:04:31]]
meeting.next: The chair said testimony would finish after the recess. The chair asked a testifier to email her property-by-property testimony to the committee.

moments.q: "We don't need more hotel units, we need more housing."
Testifier says a no-transient-rental document was a draft

trackerIssues.title: Ending apartment vacation rentals and hotel rezoning of 48 properties
